set.body:
Supporting track: Run. Recurring until the pitch.

Until the core gate (CORE) closes
1. Every Friday, post a one-paragraph note here: which steps of the four journey scripts (CORE1) pass, which core items closed that week, what is missing, and whether the 11 December target for the core gate still holds.
2. No person is asked to try a journey.

After the pre-flight (RUN5) passes
3. Every Friday, people run the four journeys on the pilot instance. Record for each: passed, or the step that failed; the time taken; hesitations.
4. Each failure becomes a note on the owning item, or one new item tagged mvp with its journey. Nothing else enters the MVP.
5. Compare with the target dates in docs/plan.md and tell the owner when a date will slip.
set.title: RUN4: Weekly check: journey scripts until the core gate closes, then rehearsals with people
